Bug_Title: BAC: Bad Applet Constructor relies on uninitialized AppletStub (BAC_BAD_APPLET_CONSTRUCTOR)
Bug_Details:
This constructor calls methods in the parent Applet that rely on the AppletStub. Since the AppletStub
isn't initialized until the init() method of this applet is called, these methods will not perform
correctly.
Bug_Explanation: The constructor calls getWidth() and getHeight() methods which rely on the AppletStub. Since the AppletStub isn't initialized until the init() method of this applet is called, these methods will not perform correctly and return 0.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the testBugTrigger method creates a new instance of BadAppletConstructor. This initializes the constructor which then attempts to call getWidth() and getHeight() methods. Since the AppletStub isn't initialized at this point, these methods return 0. Subsequently, the showBug() method will print these incorrect values, causing the test to fail.
